r: I have a letter for you.
Hello. I am wondering if you could help me?
You seem tired. Is everything alright?
Have the lytwings honored their word?

arensia_done.m: What a beautiful day, isn't it?

r: It is from Gorwath, of Crossgl...

arensia_letter_10.m: Oh really? Give it to me - quickly!

arensia_letter_20.m:
[Reading]

Oh that's cute. Tell Gorwath I love him too.
r: I'll be happy to tell him that.

arensia_lytwing_1.m: My sleep has been very restless lately.
r: Oh no, why are you not sleeping well?

arensia_lytwing_10.m: Okay thanks for letting me know. Don't let them wait too long.

arensia_lytwing_11.m: Oh wonderful! An odd request nonetheless.
r: I better go and find those fruit.
Where can I find apples and strawberries?

arensia_lytwing_12.m: You can buy apples at the Fallhaven tavern. Not sure about strawberries though.

arensia_lytwing_13.m: Oh no, they sound very difficult to deal with. I hope it gets better.

arensia_lytwing_15.m: You have done so much for me already. I will understand if you want to quit, I won't blame you.
r: I want to see this through.
The lytwings are driving me insane. I thought about this, and I can't help you any more. I am sorry.

arensia_lytwing_17.m: I appreciate your help either way.

arensia_lytwing_18.m: Oh please tell me that is the end of it?
r: I'm afraid not, they still want more.
You have to make this promise to a piece of jewellery, which I will take back to them.

arensia_lytwing_2.m: I am being taunted by naughty lytwings at night. At least that is what Rigmor tells me. They play with my hair while I sleep, and tangle it into fairy-lock knots. Every morning I wake up tired, and I spend an hour brushing out the knots. I don't know what to do!
r: I am sorry to hear that, but I cannot help you right now.
That sounds awful, can I help in any way?

arensia_lytwing_20.m: I know, I will promise on this ring I'm wearing. It belonged to my mother, and it's dear to me, but I will do anything to stop the lytwings!

arensia_lytwing_21.m: I made a promise to the ring, here take it to the lytwings!

arensia_lytwing_22.m: There is nothing else to be done, and I will have to live with the lytwings tormenting me until my last day.

r: The lytwings finally agreed to leave you in peace.

arensia_lytwing_24.m: I cannot thank you enough, $playername. You have saved my sanity!
r: Unfortunately they kept your mother's ring (Lie).
They used their magic on your ring, and asked that I give it back to you.

arensia_lytwing_25.m: That is okay. I did not expect to get it back.

arensia_lytwing_26.m: After everything you have done for me ... I want you to keep it. Please, I insist!
r: That is very generous, I won't forget it.

arensia_lytwing_27.m: I can't say that I have noticed it. A few days ago I was picking mushrooms to the west of here.

arensia_lytwing_28.m: They sure are a greedy bunch!

arensia_lytwing_29.m: Are you sure that you want to quit?
r: On second thought, I want to see this through.

arensia_lytwing_3.m: I understand. I guess I will just have to live with their mischief, and hope that I don't lose my hair, or my sanity!

r: Where can I find wild flowers?
I found some wild flowers, I just need a few more.
I have found a dozen wild flowers. I will take them to the lytwings.

arensia_lytwing_31.m: Look to the south, and southeast from here. You will see the wild flowers growing next to the trees.

arensia_lytwing_32.m: Oh I hope they accept it, and I hope they are done with their silly errands.

arensia_lytwing_33.m: You should talk to Rigmor, as she knows more about the lytwings than I do. She lives here in Fallhaven, just go north past the tavern.

arensia_lytwing_34.m: They have, I no longer wake up with fairy-locks.
r: I am happy to hear that.
I am happy to hear that.

arensia_lytwing_35.m: But I see you have the ring I gave them. You told me they kept it, which can only mean that you lied to me. You are just a common thief. Shame on you.

arensia_lytwing_36.m: I see you have my magical ring. I hope it serves you well, you deserve it.
r: I keep it safe, and it keeps me safe in return.

arensia_lytwing_4.m: You would be willing to help me? I would be so grateful if you could make them leave me alone.

r: Not yet. I still need to go talk with Rigmor to find out more.
Not yet. I am still looking for their mushroom patch. You wouldn't know where it is, perhaps?
I did, they asked that I bring them a gift of apples and strawberries.

arensia_lytwing_6.m: Please tell me you have good news?
r: They accepted the gift and will allow me to talk to them.
The lytwings are upset that you took their mushrooms. I pleaded with them, and am now waiting on their decision.
I have, and they agreed to stop pestering you if I help cut down a tree for them.
The lytwings changed their minds, and are now thinking of something else they want instead.
They now want four bottles of mead. They sure are giving me the run around today!
They took the mead, but said they need something else.
They want a dozen wild flowers.
The lytwings ask that you make a promise to never pick mushrooms from their fairy ring again.
I will take your ring to them at once!
I gave them your ring, they are busy discussing it now.

arensia_lytwing_7.m: Oh that is great news! If you need an axe, check with Jakrar, my father, over there.

arensia_lytwing_9.m: Thank you so much for helping me with the lytwings!

r: Did you see a witch around here or hear about a witch kidnapping a girl?

postman.10: Gorwath would like me to give a letter to Arensia, in Fallhaven.
postman.12: But I decided not to help him with that.
postman.20: I gave the letter to Arensia, who was visibly happy about it. Gorwath needs to hear that.
postman.30: I told Gorwath that I gave the letter to Arensia. He's happy too.

wicked_witch.10: Bela, the Fallhaven tavern keeper heard from a customer about a possible kidnapping of a girl. I should ask around town if anyone knows more.
wicked_witch.20: The "busy farmer", in the southeastern part of Fallhaven knows something about the witch.
wicked_witch.30: The "busy farmer" and his best friend, Addie, were kept captive by the witch a very long time ago when they were just kids. He never saw Addie again.
wicked_witch.40: The "busy farmer" told me that the witch's house is just south of Fallhaven. Covered in beautiful flowers.
wicked_witch.50: After meeting Bonicksa, the wicked witch, I decided to let her live and she did likewise, but not before leaving me with a very cryptic response. Saying I was "confident in my path" and that "we shall see". I wonder what that meant?
wicked_witch.60: I killed what I thought was Bonicksa, but I quickly realized that I killed an innocent girl.
wicked_witch.65: I "killed" Bonicksa again, only for her to reappear.
wicked_witch.70: Bonicksa lives and could not be defeated. But I learned a huge life lesson.
wicked_witch.80: I discovered a young girl named Emmeline just behind the 'wicked witch's' house. The witch was really Emmeline under a spell from Bonicksa.
wicked_witch.85: Emmeline asked me to get her "a lot" of those "Tonics of Blood".
wicked_witch.90: Emmeline told me to head east of the witch's house to find the undead that know about the 'Tonic of Blood'.
wicked_witch.95: I gave Emmeline 25 of the "Tonics of Blood" that she asked for and she was then able to leave that terrible place.
wicked_witch.96: I gave Emmeline 20 of the 25 "Tonics of Blood" that she asked for and she was then able to leave that terrible place.

fallhaven_lytwings.1: I met Arensia in Fallhaven. She is being taunted by lytwings while she slumbers. I agreed to help get rid of the mischevious creatures. I should talk to Rigmor to find out more, she lives north of the tavern.
fallhaven_lytwings.10: Rigmor told me that lytwings live near large rings of mushroom growth, I should look for these in the forest surrounding Fallhaven.
fallhaven_lytwings.11: I have to take a gift of two red apples and two strawberries before I can talk to the lytwings. They cast some kind of spell on me for not bringing them these fruit, it made me feel very tired.
fallhaven_lytwings.12: The lytwings accepted my gift, and I can now talk with them.
fallhaven_lytwings.13: I offered my help to the lytwings in exchange for leaving Arensia alone. They are considering my request. I should check in with them shortly, to hear their decision.
fallhaven_lytwings.20: The lytwings asked that I chop down a gnarly old tree that is inside their mushroom ring. They insisted that I use an iron axe because the cursed bark of the tree cannot be cut by other tools.
fallhaven_lytwings.21: I was about to swing my axe, when the lytwings stopped me. They have changed their minds about chopping down the tree. I am beginning to think they are indecisive on purpose.
fallhaven_lytwings.30: The lytwings want four bottles of mead. I can probably find some at the Fallhaven tavern.
fallhaven_lytwings.31: They took the mead, and turned around saying they want something else. I can now see why Rigmor said they are full of mischief! But I have no other choice but to continue this fool's errand if I want to help Arensia.
fallhaven_lytwings.40: I have to find twelve wild flowers for the lytwings. I wonder where I could find those. Perhaps Arensia will know.
fallhaven_lytwings.41: They accepted the flowers, and as expected, said they want something else! How many more times will they make me run around?
fallhaven_lytwings.90: The lytwings want a token of Arensia's promise that she will not to pick their mushrooms again. I sense they are not playing another prank this time, they seemed intent about this task.
fallhaven_lytwings.91: Arensia made a promise to her mother's ring, and then she gave it to me. I should take it to the lytwings at once.
fallhaven_lytwings.92: I gave Arensia's ring to the lytwings. Just when I thought it was done, they said they need something else! I am waiting on their decision.
fallhaven_lytwings.99: The lytwings have agreed to stop taunting Arensia. I should go tell her.
fallhaven_lytwings.100: Arensia was elated to hear that the lytwings will no longer taunt her.
fallhaven_lytwings.101: I could not take the absurd errands any more. I am no longer helping Arensia with her lytwing problem.
fallhaven_lytwings.102: I lied to Arensia's and kept her mother's ring for myself.
fallhaven_lytwings.103: Arensia gave me her magical promise ring as reward for helping her.
